obligations.note: The change names ticket CHG-24991. It is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-05, before the change was opened. Its components (mortgage.servicing, mortgage.tests) cover both touched paths: RateQuote.java and the mortgage test directory.

The only code_review approval comes from d.farrell@fernbrook.example. The directory lists that address for Declan Farrell, who is the author, so this is self-approval and does not count. No independent change_approver has approved.
The approval record names the head commit efcc8e19, and the change has no later commits. It still provides no valid independent approval (see CHG-2).

run.json reports success on the head commit from ci-runner-07, started 2026-10-06. However, the attached JUnit reports were produced on hostname dev-laptop-7.local with timestamp 2026-10-23, which is after the review time of 2026-10-12. They cannot be the reports of that CI run, so a full-suite pass on the final commit is not reliably evidenced.

No acceptance-ledger entry covers RateQuote.java or the new test file. The ledger entries cover Approvals, Underwriting, Policy, payments.py, audit.py and routes.py, none of which changed, so no evidence lapses.

summary: The change adds a pure helper, RateQuote.isSupportedTerm, plus unit tests in the non-security-sensitive mortgage.servicing component. It touches no product obligation's scope paths, closed domains or protected paths. However, the only code review approval was given by the author, Declan Farrell, under his alias d.farrell@fernbrook.example. This violates CHG-2's independent-approval requirement. In addition, the JUnit reports come from a developer machine and are dated after the review time, so they do not reliably evidence the CI run. The change is rejected.
